context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren reflect on a project together.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business chat; vocabulary (決意/伴う/課長/させる/話し合い) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新しい部署を、立ち上げる決意をした。
lines.en: I've resolved to launch a new department.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大きな決意ですね。誰が率いますか?
lines.en: A big resolve. Who will lead it?
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新しい課長に、任せようと思う。
lines.en: I'm thinking of entrusting a new section chief.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 課長と、よく話し合いたいですね。
lines.en: I'd like to discuss it well with the chief.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 変化には、痛みが伴うものだ。
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: チームを、納得させて進めます。
lines.en: I'll get the team on board and proceed.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 話し合いを重ねて、決めよう。
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 決意を持って、取り組みます。
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
